learning_outcomes.text: Plans, executes, and interprets machine tests.

Knows the dimensioning, calculation, and design of pressure vessels. Knows the basic concepts of different design codes. Solves practical and real cases of pressure vessels. Applies different methodologies for dimensioning pressure equipment or elements.

syllabus_topics: Pressure equipment: Calculation and dimensioning of main elements
Pressure equipment: Test pressure and maximum operating pressure
Flanged joints: Standardization of flanges and gaskets
Welding in pressure vessels: Design of welded joints
Welding in pressure vessels: Welding processes
Welding in pressure vessels: Welding procedures
Welding in pressure vessels: Qualification of procedures
Welding in pressure vessels: Qualification of welders
Materials for pressure vessels: Material properties
Materials for pressure vessels: Design requirements
Inspection of pressure vessels: Welding inspection methods
Inspection of pressure vessels: Acceptance criteria
teaching_methods: Introductory activities: Different calculation methodologies used by various design codes.
Lectures: Lecture sessions introduce the theory for solving real cases.
Problem/exercise solving in ordinary classroom: Resolution of real cases with active student participation.
Assignments: Assignments to be developed by the student.
Personalized attention: Individual attention during consultation hours.
assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a practical assignment (25%) and two partial tests (35% and 40%). For the second call (resit), a single final exam will account for 100% of the qualification.
